The strict frozen H audit is also complete on the only raw archive with bookTicker plus per-message dual-token L2: about three hours on one UTC day, 34 immutable bookTicker-first signals, one decision-time send candidate, and zero qualifying fills at 300/350/400/500 ms when a fill requires at least five shares on the direct token ladder at the frozen limit. This audit is deliberately conservative and is not the full deployed retry path: it excludes trade fallback, retries after no-send/kill, mirrored liquidity, and sub-five-share partial fills. Separately, the predeclared near-certain [0.95,0.99) side passed its unused 2025-09-15..2026-03-13 history segment at +2.43c/share (market-cluster t=6.74, 279 markets), but observed next-60-second trades prove pricing rather than our fill capacity.
